name: ZaakPay
author: zaakpay

sections.description:
Easily integrate Zaakpay, a secure payment gateway, into your WooCommerce store. This plugin allows your customers to pay using credit cards, debit cards, net banking, and other supported methods via Zaakpay’s trusted payment processing system.

A few notes about the sections above:

  • Supports major payment methods including credit/debit cards, etc.
  • Seamless integration with WooCommerce checkout.
  • Secure and reliable transaction processing via Zaakpay.
  • Real-time payment status updates and error handling.
